reason: The Cinnamon desktop process crashed with SIGSEGV during seed 5, ending the desktop session.

crashContext.precedingWalk: A put.gd region overlay had been open earlier; immediately before the crash the walk rapidly disabled and re-enabled Virtual-2 and changed Virtual-1 to 800x600. No put.gd overlay was present at the crash checkpoint.
crashContext.disposition: Desktop-process crash recorded in the run summary; no put.gd issue filed.

triage.stuckGrabMarks: False positives caused by later selector invocations or fence-denied Escape actions; the selectors subsequently cleared or progressed.
triage.foreignFocus: Firefox on the published nightly release page was a harness-owned foreign window and was closed; no put.gd focus defect.
